title: Quorum credit economy simulation
description:
Agent-based simulation of the review-credit economy used by Quorum: An Open Journal of Information Technology (https://jquorum.org), a journal that is free for readers and authors and uses peer review as its currency. Every first complete review of a manuscript earns one credit, and one credit pays for one submission.

The repository contains the model, the scenario definitions with their random seeds, the complete outputs and the figures behind the simulation study in: Ozer, M. (2026). Paying for publication with peer review: Design and simulation of a fee-free, credit-based open access journal for information technology.
